themes.title: Far-right AfD party congress sparks mass protests in Germany
themes.blurb: Germany's far-right AfD party congress in Erfurt has drawn massive protests, with tens of thousands demonstrating against the party's policies and leadership. The event has seen clashes between protesters and police, highlighting deep societal divisions and concerns over the AfD's growing influence ahead of regional elections.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD party congress in Erfurt faced large-scale protests, with police reporting over 30,000 demonstrators. The event saw re-election of co-leaders Alice Weidel and Tino Chrupalla, amid debates over the party's extremist ties.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: French far-right figures like Marion Maréchal have drawn parallels to Germany's AfD protests, emphasizing the broader European trend of rising far-right movements and public backlash.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: UK's Reform UK faced scrutiny over leadership and funding, with protests and media criticism mirroring the broader European far-right backlash seen in Germany.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian far-right parties have closely watched the AfD's congress, with internal debates over extremism and electoral strategies reflecting similar tensions within their own ranks.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Spain's Vox party has drawn comparisons to AfD's rise, with protests against its policies in regional governments echoing the German demonstrations.

themes.title: PP-Vox coalitions reshape Spain's regional governments
themes.blurb: Spain's conservative Partido Popular (PP) and far-right Vox have formed coalition governments in multiple regions, most notably in Andalusia. These alliances reflect a broader rightward shift in Spanish politics, with Vox gaining unprecedented influence in regional governance.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox secured key roles in Andalusia's government, including vice-presidency and control over tourism and justice portfolios, marking its most significant regional power grab yet.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Partido Popular
countries.note: PP leader Juanma Moreno formed a coalition with Vox in Andalusia, abandoning his centrist stance and embracing far-right policies to secure a third term as president.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian far-right parties have closely monitored Spain's PP-Vox coalitions, drawing parallels to their own regional governance strategies and potential national alliances.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: France's far-right RN has analyzed Spain's regional coalitions, using them as a case study for potential future alliances in French politics.

themes.title: Right-wing parties target LGBTQ+ rights in Europe
themes.blurb: Across Europe, right-wing and far-right parties are intensifying their opposition to LGBTQ+ rights, with legislative proposals and public statements challenging progressive policies. This trend spans multiple countries, reflecting a coordinated pushback against recent advances in LGBTQ+ equality.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox has led opposition to LGBTQ+ rights in Spain, particularly in Andalusia, where its coalition with PP has raised concerns about rollbacks on progressive policies.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Poland's PiS has maintained its conservative stance on LGBTQ+ issues, with recent statements and policies reinforcing traditional family values and opposing progressive legislation.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian far-right parties have targeted LGBTQ+ rights, with legislative proposals and public statements challenging progressive policies, particularly in education and family law.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: France's RN has intensified its opposition to LGBTQ+ rights, with leaders like Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella framing progressive policies as threats to traditional values.

themes.title: Javier Milei's regional alliances and anti-socialism bloc
themes.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei is actively building regional alliances with right-wing leaders across Latin America, positioning himself as a key figure in an emerging anti-socialist bloc. His diplomatic efforts include attending inaugurations of far-right leaders and promoting a shared ideological agenda.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei is attending inaugurations of far-right leaders in Peru and Colombia, seeking to build a regional anti-socialist alliance and strengthen his international profile.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The Trump administration has shown support for Milei's anti-socialist agenda, with diplomatic engagements reflecting shared ideological goals in the Americas.

countries.name: 🇵🇪 Peru (external)
countries.note: Milei will attend Keiko Fujimori's inauguration in Peru, signaling support for her right-wing government and reinforcing regional anti-socialist ties.

countries.name: 🇨🇴 Colombia (external)
countries.note: Milei is set to attend the inauguration of Colombia's far-right president Abelardo de la Espriella, further solidifying his role in the regional anti-socialist bloc.

themes.title: Marine Le Pen's eligibility ruling dominates French politics
themes.blurb: France's far-right leader Marine Le Pen faces a critical court ruling on her eligibility for the 2027 presidential election. The decision, expected within days, has become a defining moment in French politics, with potential implications for the far-right's electoral prospects and the broader political landscape.
